earnings.title: Arista Networks, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Revenue of $3.66 billion, an increase of 20.5% compared to the second quarter of 2026, and an increase of 58.5% from the third quarter of 2025.
GAAP and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.22 and $1.20, respectively, compared to GAAP and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $0.67 and $0.77 in the third quarter of 2025.
GAAP and non-GAAP operating margin of 44.9% and 49.1%, respectively, compared to GAAP and non-GAAP operating margin of 42.4% and 48.6% in the third quarter of 2025.

quotes.text: Arista registered another momentous quarter with the highest year-over-year revenue growth since our IPO and record profitability, surpassing even my high expectations.
quotes.by: Jayshree Ullal, Chairperson and CEO of Arista Networks

quotes.text: This quarter brought a true trifecta for our company, setting new record highs in revenue growth, net income, and EPS. I’m incredibly proud of the Arista team for their hard work in driving such outstanding performance for our shareholders.

outlook: Delivered total revenues in Q3 2026 of approximately $3.66 billion, exceeding guidance of $3.3 billion while growing 58.5%, the highest year-over-year revenue growth since our IPO.
Non-GAAP diluted net income per share of $1.26 - $1.30.
